description: The places outside the generated operation table that may hold a request call or a /v1/ path, each with its reason (tools/check-handwritten-client.mjs). Every other file of the packages and crates makes no request of its own.

exemptions.reason: the one place the TypeScript client hands a request to fetch; it holds no path of its own and refuses any URL outside the base URL
signKeyRotation names the rotation endpoint as the audience of its proofs; it signs, it sends nothing
signStatsReport and sendStatsReport: the statistics sender of stats-only use (no token, no client), over the statistics path the contract pins
the one place the Rust client hands a request to reqwest; it holds no path of its own and refuses any URL outside the base URL
sign_key_rotation names the rotation endpoint as the audience of its proofs; it signs, it sends nothing
the statistics checks and signer name the statistics path the contract pins; the crate sends the report through the client
